title: Product turn
approach: A clean product film: reveal, a slow turn to show the detail, a hero frame to end on. Three beats, four seconds each. Change the product in each beat's words.

beats.brief: The product appears out of soft shadow on a plain pedestal.
beats.shot: A ceramic coffee cup on a plain stone pedestal, soft light slowly revealing it from shadow, clean studio background, product photography, minimal, sharp detail.

beats.brief: Close and slow: the camera circles to show texture and shape.
beats.shot: Macro close-up of the ceramic coffee cup's glazed surface and handle, the camera slowly orbiting, soft studio light, shallow depth of field, product photography.

beats.brief: The hero frame: the whole product, centred, held still to the end.
beats.shot: The ceramic coffee cup centred on the stone pedestal, steam rising gently, warm key light, clean background, hero product shot, still camera.
